title: Zesty Venezuelan Plantain Skewers
description: A festive Venezuelan dish featuring candied peel and grilled plantains, perfect for any occasion. This dish is kosher-friendly and has a nutty, aerated flavor.
instructions: Preheat the yakimono grill to medium high heat.
Peel the plantains and cut them into 1 inch pieces.
Thread the plantain pieces onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
Brush the plantains with vegetable oil and season with salt, black pepper, and lime juice.
Grill the plantain skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until they are caramelized and tender.
Meanwhile, combine the brown sugar and water in a saucepan and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat and simmer for 5 minutes, or until the sugar has dissolved and the mixture is syrupy.
Add the chopped candied orange peel to the sugar syrup and stir to combine.
Brush the grilled plantain skewers with the sugar and orange peel mixture.
Serve the plantain skewers hot, garnished with additional candied orange peel if desired.
